weeks.title: Ancient & Classical Art: Elements and principles of art
weeks.instructor_overview: Introduce and develop elements and principles of art within the context of Ancient & Classical Art. Use explicit instruction, worked examples or models, guided practice, and independent application.
learning_objectives: Identify and apply principles related to elements and principles of art.
Create or analyze work using intentional artistic choices.
Reflect on process, technique, and revision.
warm_up: Recall one idea related to elements and principles of art.
Answer a short retrieval question from the previous week.
Write one question you expect this week's lesson to answer.

Independent application and reflection
